---
title: "Glossary"
---

| Term | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| **Pico** | Open Engineering engineering entity (behaviour + state + identity) |
| **Pico Runtime SPI** | Abstract interface: deploy, invoke, inspect, … |
| **NativeRuntime** | In-process volatile adapter |
| **DurableRuntime** | SQLite-backed durable adapter (celld-shaped reference) |
| **celld** | Self-hosted Durable Objects–style runtime (experimental) |
| **Durable state** | State that survives process restart |
| **Hibernation** | Release execution resources while keeping durable state |
| **Runtime class** | Semantic request (e.g. `durable`), not an implementation name |
